instruction: Block any response that explicitly agrees to, initiates, or commits to processing payment using card data (including test or dummy numbers) disclosed by the buyer — *only when the seller treats the disclosed card data as actionable input for immediate off-platform settlement*, even if labeled as academic, hypothetical, or non-production.
trigger_pattern: explicit acceptance and operational commitment to process payment using card details (PAN, CVV, or equivalent) provided by the buyer — where the seller treats those details as functionally valid input for immediate off-platform settlement
